name: attachment
title: Attachment
description: A row of attached-file chips, each with a thumbnail or icon, a name, a status line like Uploading 64% and a small remove button. A second row shows tall image tiles plus a dashed Add file tile.
use: A chat or form composer needs to show several uploaded files with their progress, size and a quick remove.
avoid: The chips are display-only; the demo has no real picker or dropzone, so you wire the file input yourself.
a11y: The shimmer and spinner keep moving with no reduced-motion check; icon-only remove buttons are labelled only in the demo. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark composer card holds a horizontal row of rounded chips, each a small image or file icon with a name, a grey status line and a tiny x button. Below sit three tall image tiles with names and sizes, and a dashed Add file tile.
behaves: Uploading and processing chips spin a small spinner and shimmer their filenames; when the upload lands the status swaps to its size and the shimmer stops. Each chip can be removed with its x, and the tile row opens the file picker.
customise: Compose each chip from media, content, title, description and action children; size, orientation and state are props. The spinner, shimmer and error styling are preset classes.
weight: light: Plain divs and buttons with colour transitions; the spinner and shimmer are simple CSS animations.
